findings: All fixed-launch ARM/AArch64/MIPS per-function Ir/Dr/Dw events are identical across the four variants on both hosts.
Original-image libc memset work changes disappear when the guest filename, inode, file length and ASLR are controlled. Prior counts do not prove source-added initialization work.
Native ARM throughput still differs on Intel with effectively identical retired instruction/branch totals; one PMU sample per variant does not establish the microarchitectural cause.
AMD EPYC 9V45 exposes no requested hardware events after permission change; Intel 6975P-C does. Both kernel settings were restored and verified.

native_memset_probe.reason: Only __memset_chk_ifunc was discoverable, and it was not called. GDB returned successfully without useful observations; no native alignment claim is supported.

limitations: This ARM-only timing round cannot erase previously measured AArch64/ARM regressions on other hosts.
